title: Weekend Live Music @ Old Glory Distilling Co.
event_description: Live acoustic and original music performances in the outdoor Silo Park venue with craft cocktails and made-from-scratch food available.
backline: PA System and stage equipment provided
event_venue_information:
Old Glory Distilling Co. Silo Park

A premium outdoor music venue hosted by a craft bourbon distillery. The Silo Park features a full-service bar with handcrafted Tennessee spirits and bourbon-focused cocktails. The restaurant offers scratch-made cuisine designed to pair with their spirits. Equipment includes professional sound system and stage. The venue hosts live music every Friday and Saturday with rotating local musicians. Family-friendly atmosphere with fire pits and lawn games.

title: Saturday Afternoon Live Music @ Old Glory Distilling Co.
event_description: Weekend afternoon live music series featuring local and regional musicians in an outdoor setting with food truck and full bar service.
backline: PA System and stage equipment provided
event_venue_information:
Old Glory Distilling Co. Silo Park

A premium outdoor music venue with professional sound system and stage. The Silo Bar serves craft cocktails featuring the distillery's handcrafted Tennessee bourbon and whiskey. Full restaurant menu available for dine-in service. The park offers a family-friendly environment with fire pits bocce ball and cornhole. Outdoor seating accommodates groups of all sizes.

title: Live Music @ Blackhorse Pub and Brewery
event_description: Weekend live music performances at downtown Clarksville's historic brewery location featuring local musicians in an upstairs taproom with multiple screens and pool tables.
event_venue_information:
Blackhorse Pub and Brewery

Founded in 1992 Blackhorse has been a downtown Clarksville anchor for over 30 years. The venue features handcrafted ales brewed on-site with a full pub menu including famous beer cheese pizza and burgers. The upstairs Taproom is open until 3:00 AM and features pool shuffleboard and a full bar. Saturday and Sunday brunch service runs from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM.

title: Live Music @ Tippers Neighborhood Pub
event_description: Live music performances most weekends at this family-owned pub in Clarksville featuring local bands and a welcoming community atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
Tippers Neighborhood Pub

A family-owned neighborhood pub serving Clarksville for over 30 years. Known for their famous wings particularly the Mango Habanero and Parmesan Garlic varieties. The pub features live music most weekends with karaoke and pool tables. Happy Hour runs daily from 3:00 PM to 7:00 PM with discounted beer and cocktails. The spacious bar area accommodates live performances with good acoustics.

title: Live Music @ Rookies Sports Bar
event_description: Local live musicians and karaoke nights every Friday and Saturday at this sports bar featuring 30 beer options and 12 TV screens for game watching.
event_venue_information:
Rookies Sports Bar

A lively sports bar with 12 HD television screens for watching games. Features over 30 different beer selections and a full bar. Menu includes classic pub favorites like wings burgers and appetizers with reasonable prices. The bar hosts karaoke every Friday night with a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Thursday night darts tournament with sign-ups at 7:00 PM.

title: Live Music @ Scooter's Place
event_description: Live band performances every weekend featuring country rock and southern rock music with a full bar and grill menu available.
event_venue_information:
Scooter's Place

A bar and grill hosting regular live music performances with country and rock bands. The venue features a spacious indoor area with a full-service bar and grill menu. Friendly staff and lively atmosphere make it popular for weekend entertainment. Open from noon to 3:00 AM most days of the week with extended hours on weekends.

title: Live Music @ Mike's Bar and Grill
event_description: Live music performances with local bands covering country rock and classic hits in a venue with 7 big-screen TVs 2 pool tables and 2 dart boards.
event_venue_information:
Mike's Bar and Grill

A vibrant bar and grill known for live music performances most weekends. Features 7 flat-screen TVs and a 125-inch projector screen for sports viewing. The venue has 2 pool tables and 2 dart boards plus a spacious patio area. Happy Hour runs Tuesday through Sunday from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM with domestic beer for $2 and well drinks for $2.50.
